reviews.originalQuote: The switch is too stiff to press with one hand.
It turns on accidentally in my pocket all the time.
Runtime is great, lasts a whole week on AA batteries.
Very dim on low mode, barely visible in the dark.
The mode switching is confusing, it cycles through too many settings.
Gets hot quickly on the highest setting.
Solid build, comfortable length for daily carry.
Battery compatibility is misleading, the listing says all sizes work.
The switch feels loose after a few months of use.
It remembers the last mode I used, really convenient.
A bit bulky and long for an EDC light.
Battery life drains fast with 14500 cells.
